raw_input.problem: We run a service request management system for 200+ field technicians. Assigning tickets to technicians takes the dispatcher 2-3 hours a day and is based largely on intuition.

final_content.cel_rd: Develop an algorithm for automatically assigning field service requests to technicians based on location, skills, and workload.
wymagane_kompetencje: Knowledge of routing algorithms / vehicle routing problem
final_content.zakres_projektu: Analyze the current process, review field service optimization literature, and implement and test the assignment algorithm on synthetic data.
final_content.oczekiwany_rezultat: Working algorithm prototype and report evaluating assignment quality versus the current manual method.
final_content.pierwszy_milestone: After 2 weeks: formalized problem model and selected algorithmic approach with rationale.
final_content.suggested_researcher_profile: Candidate with a computer science or applied mathematics background who understands VRP and field scheduling, can implement and evaluate algorithms on realistic data, and communicates results in an operations-focused report.

raw_input.problem: We are looking for a current literature review on biodegradable hydrogel-based drug delivery systems, with a particular focus on applications in the treatment of chronic wounds.

final_content.cel_rd: Systematic literature review (2019-2025) on biodegradable hydrogels as drug delivery systems for chronic wound therapy.
wymagane_kompetencje: Ability to conduct scientific literature reviews (PubMed, Scopus)
final_content.zakres_projektu: Review at least 60 publications, synthesize findings, assess TRL maturity of selected solutions, and recommend 3-5 research directions.
final_content.oczekiwany_rezultat: A 20-30 page report with comparative materials table, researcher landscape, and recommendations for the R&D team.
final_content.pierwszy_milestone: After 1 week: review protocol approved by the company and a list of 15 key publications.
final_content.suggested_researcher_profile: Researcher experienced in polymer chemistry or biomaterials, comfortable with bibliographic databases, and able to connect hydrogel mechanical and biological properties with clinical potential and identify R&D gaps.

raw_input.problem: Our defect detection model for photovoltaic panels works well in the lab, but accuracy drops by 15-20pp in production due to variable lighting conditions.

final_content.cel_rd: Investigate and implement data augmentation and domain adaptation methods to improve robustness of PV defect detection in varying lighting conditions.
wymagane_kompetencje: Computer vision and deep learning (PyTorch or TensorFlow)
final_content.zakres_projektu: Analyze causes of accuracy degradation, run augmentation and domain adaptation experiments on company-provided data, and deliver a report with recommendations.
final_content.oczekiwany_rezultat: Report with experiment results plus the best data-processing pipeline ready for integration.
final_content.pierwszy_milestone: After 3 weeks: problem diagnosis and baseline experiment results for 3 augmentation approaches.
final_content.suggested_researcher_profile: Computer vision engineer with production model and domain shift experience (lighting, industrial cameras), capable of designing experiments, measuring comparative metrics, and preparing deployment recommendations.

raw_input.problem: We want to assess whether using an LLM to automatically categorize and prioritize helpdesk tickets (about 500/day) is technically feasible and cost-effective.

final_content.cel_rd: Proof of concept for automated helpdesk ticket classification and prioritization using language models, including technical and economic feasibility assessment.
wymagane_kompetencje: NLP and language models (fine-tuning or prompt engineering)
API and LLM infrastructure cost estimation
final_content.zakres_projektu: Analyze a sample of tickets (provided by the company), implement 2-3 LLM approaches, compare against a baseline (keyword matching), and deliver a cost-benefit report.
final_content.oczekiwany_rezultat: Working POC plus report with deployment recommendation (proceed / do not proceed) and ROI estimate.
final_content.pierwszy_milestone: After 1 week: analyzed sample of 200 tickets and selected model for testing.
final_content.suggested_researcher_profile: NLP specialist able to define a baseline, design evaluation (metrics, sample), and estimate LLM API operating costs and quality risks for SLA-bound helpdesk workflows.
